verdict.rationale: Fathom documents its own event-triggered automations. Webhooks fire on new meeting content, configurable keyword alerts and topic monitoring flag moments, and CRM fields update automatically after meetings. These are fixed event-to-action features with limited configuration, not a general rule builder. Missing for 10: user-defined conditional rules (if/then logic over meeting events), a choice of actions beyond fixed webhook/CRM/alert behaviors, detailed docs on configuring alert rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
